scope: Supplementary accounting for the frozen twelve-query negative result. Read only saved C34-selected winners; do not rerun19 shifts, pick channels, fit weights or alter any decision.
identity: S=sum_pc [(a_pc-mean(a_c))*(b_pc-mean(b_c)) / (||a_c||*||b_c||*number_of_reference_active_channels)]. Exact constant channels contribute zero. Sum of cell/channel terms must equal the already saved score at the already saved winner.
quantities: Per channel and cell signed contributions for own and foreign. For C34 explicitly report sum from fixed T4/T5 indices4:12 and remaining26, not a new ranking policy. C8 score at C34 winning shift compared descriptively with ready C8 maximum to distinguish channel averaging from winning-shift change.
spatial_caveat: Convert existing winner query to physical pixels, count points inside own GT rectangle only, foreign only, both or neither. Ground truth used only after scoring. Rectangles are not pixel masks; point inclusion does not establish ownership of nonlocal neural activity.
stop: Identity and current maps unchanged, accounting error<=1e-10. No deployment or independent-validation claim. Failed identities remain failures; attribution is algebra, not causal intervention.
